name: dot-field
title: Halftone dot field
description: A grid of halftone dots breathes on a ring-shaped wave. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

props.name: dot
props.doc: Colour of the dots where the wave is low.

props.name: dotHigh
props.doc: Colour of the dots at the crest of the wave.

props.name: spacing
props.doc: Distance between dot centres, in pixels.

props.name: size
props.doc: The largest dot, as a fraction of the spacing.

props.name: waveLength
props.doc: Length of the waves as a multiple of the default. Higher is calmer.

props.name: speed
props.doc: How fast the wave travels. Whole numbers loop seamlessly over 10 seconds.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Grain amount over the whole frame.
